sub_indicators.label: HMIS
sub_indicators.subject: digital.rural
sub_indicators.text: Digitalisation of rural health clinics: HMIS
criteria: A dated source states that routine health reporting is not entered digitally at any level of the health system.

A digital reporting system is used by hospitals only or in some districts, or a national rollout is contracted or being prepared: staff trained, equipment delivered or an agreement signed. Primary clinics do not use it, beyond pilot sites.
A national system takes the clinics' reports, which are keyed in at district level from the clinics' paper forms. A minority of primary clinics enter their own reports, or no figure is published.
More than half of primary clinics enter their own reports at the facility. The figure is a published share, or a count given with its total.
At least 90 per cent of primary clinics enter their own reports at the facility, on a figure published within the past two years. Reporting completeness is published as well.

sub_indicators.label: EMR
sub_indicators.subject: digital.rural
sub_indicators.text: Digitalisation of rural health clinics: EMR
criteria: A dated source states that patient records are kept on paper at every level of the health system.

Electronic patient records are in use in some hospitals or pilot facilities, or a national system is procured or being prepared: staff trained, equipment delivered or an agreement signed. Primary clinics do not use them, beyond pilot sites.

Electronic patient records are in use in most hospitals, or in primary clinics in some districts, but each record stays in the facility that made it. A minority of primary clinics use them, or no figure is published.
More than half of primary clinics keep electronic patient records, entered at the point of care. Each record is held under a unique patient identifier and can be retrieved at another facility.
At least 90 per cent of primary clinics keep such shared records, on a figure published within the past two years. A record can be retrieved anywhere in the public network.
